sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile, Auditory, Unaware), Fuinjutsu

system.description:
You perform a less intense version of the Mind body transfer technique on an animal or some creatures with less mental fortitude than a human. Select a single target creature that you can see within range. Target creature must succeed an Intelligence saving throw.

Critical Success: No further effects.

Success: Its attitude towards you becomes Indifferent until the end of its next turn, as you blank out its memories of meeting you and your allies for a moment.

Failure: Its attitude towards you becomes Friendly for the next minute until you or your allies would perform a hostile action towards it or its own allies.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, its attitude towards you becomes Helpful until you or your allies would perform a hostile action towards it or its own allies. The affected creature will fight for you if asked. While they are friendly towards you, you can command them with both verbal and non-verbal actions. You can also understand things about them, such as them being happy, scared, or excited.
